http/websocket_session#

Dedicated upgraded transport owner.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Dedicated upgraded transport owner. Constructors bind only; first started() or public operation starts its supervised reader and writer. close() aborts; role close(code,reason) performs a bounded graceful handshake.
